title: Lomography
content: Photo by scarecrowindisguise with a Lomography Diana F+ loaded with Lomography X-Pro SlideLomography is a form of analog photography using film cameras that allow for long exposures, double exposures and vignetting.The images exhibit what used to be thought of as flaws, but now are regarded as agreeable virtues: light leaks, graininess, blurring, bleaching, and over-saturation, making them resemble some Instagram filters or Photoshop techniques.The movement began in Austria in the 1990s, with advocates using a small Russian toy camera called a Lomo LC-A, but other cameras and models have been brought into service.Images from Business Insider
